row:
Dr. Burt believes that Health is a force within the body and mind and with the proper direction and support, good health can be established and maintained for a better life. Dr. Eduard Burt will share his knowledge during the years of education and clinical experience with all who seek to restore or maintain health and want to become an active part in their own future well-being. His main San Leandro Chiropractic office is located near Bay Fair Bart Station and Bay Fair Mall.

History
Established in 2001.

Dr. Eduard Burt was born in the southwest of Ukraine. He has moved to the United States with his family in the summer of 1992. Dr. Burt holds degree of B.S. in Clinical Psychology from Brooklyn College in Brooklyn, New York and Doctor's Degree In Chiropractic from Life Chiropractic College West., Hayward in California. Fluently speaks Russian and English and broken Spanish.
